name: 89501 · Reno, NV
findings: ZIP 89501 (Reno) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89501 (Reno) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 89501 (Reno) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.
